Y9.quote: We evaluate across discrete and continuous control settings: (1) Grid-World for intuitive analysis, and (2) Locomotion and Manipulation benchmarks using MuJoCo (Brockman et al., 2016), Fetch Reach (Plappert et al., 2018), and the UR5e manipulator (Tassa et al., 2018; Chuang, 2023). To systematically test robustness, we introduce fixed obstacles in the Grid-World that cause the transition kernel to deviate from ideal rotational symmetry. We report results on Grid-World as the number of obstacles increases.
